newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas to keep main stake in Advertising.
newsitem.headline: Havas to keep main stake in Advertising.

text.p: Havas Advertising said in a statement that Havas had decided to remain the main shareholder of the company, cutting short market rumours the media group might sell its stake.
These rumours were fuelled after Generale des Eaux took a 30 percent stake in Havas in February.

"Havas is and will remain the main shareholder of Havas Advertising," the statement said, adding Havas Advertising aimed to have in the short term "a level of margin development and a level of profits sufficient to cut debts".
It said that in 1996, its profits were up 26 percent and margin by 9.1 percent.
"Havas Advertising wants to be in the world top five before 2000," it said.
Havas Advertising chairman Alain de Pouzilhac said he had named Bob Schmetterer chairman and chief executive officer of Euro RSCG Worldwide.
